purpose: Behavior contract for style-agnostic image/video style taxonomy, reference policy, compilation and review.

cases.prompt: 把宋韵诗意历史电视剧拆成媒介、文化时代、服装、色彩、光线、摄影和表演原子，不要把宋韵作为一个不可解释的 Prompt token。
assertions: style is multidimensional
culture, costume, cinematography and performance are separate scopes
named style is translated into observable grammar
identity is not owned by Style

cases.prompt: 为一个原创宋韵视觉包制定参考策略：创建期使用服装、场景、摄影和视频运镜参考，运行期只在风格漂移或需要签名运镜时附加少量参考。
assertions: design-time and runtime references are separated
image and temporal references have different roles
mode is adaptive
extract and ignore scopes are explicit
rights status is recorded

cases.prompt: 保持同一 CharacterSpec 的脸型、眼型、身材比例和性格，把宋韵真人电视剧转换为高留白黑白漫画，再转换为自然主义二维手绘动画。
cases.expectedOutput: two provider-neutral StyleCompile payloads with exact identity preservation
assertions: medium and representation change while CharacterSpec remains exact
comic linework/shading and animation motion are separate
temporal rules are explicit for video
style conflicts do not silently rewrite identity

cases.prompt: 为已定义角色的美妆近景编译克制写实表现：保留自然不对称和可见微纹理，适度理想化与修图；不得改变角色肤色、皮肤状态或面部结构。
assertions: realism dimensions are independently bounded
profile is provider neutral and not a quality score
CharacterSpec identity remains protected
CharacterAppearanceState physical skin state remains protected
microdetail is compiled for the requested shot scale
no output realism guarantee is made

cases.prompt: 候选图保留了宋韵色盘，但背景复制了参考图的宫殿布局，且妆容变成现代网红妆；请只提出最小风格修复。
cases.expectedOutput: StyleReview with evidence-scoped drift and one repair variable
assertions: reference contamination is separated from palette success
modern makeup is a style failure
identity and scene parents remain immutable
one-variable repair and stop condition are present

cases.prompt: 只有一张黑白漫画风格图，但要求精确复制视频中的镜头运动、衣袖惯性和剪辑节奏。
cases.expectedOutput: temporal evidence gap or conditional StyleReferencePlan
assertions: still image is not treated as temporal proof
camera motion and secondary motion gaps are visible
video reference or structured temporal semantics are requested
runtime plan can be blocked on missing temporal evidence
